camelback-echo-canyon.note: Echo Canyon Trail closes 8am to 5pm daily under the City of Phoenix Trail Heat Safety Program on days when the National Weather Service issues an Excessive Heat Warning for the Phoenix metro area. south-kaibab-ooh-aah.note: Heat safety advisory: Grand Canyon National Park rates today's heat risk at Phantom Ranch as Major, a major risk to anyone exposed to the sun and active; the park continues to urge visitors to avoid Inner Canyon trails between 10am and 4pm. South Kaibab Trail is fully sun-exposed with no water source; the South Kaibab Trailhead water source is on. No Excessive Heat Warning was active for the Grand Canyon area below 4000 feet as of the August 13, 2026 morning check. No Flash Flood Watch is active for Grand Canyon Country. Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park (key hiking messages, updated August 12, 2026); National Weather Service Flagstaff.

Water is on at the Bright Angel Trailhead, Mile-and-a-Half Resthouse, and Three-Mile Resthouse; water status can change suddenly due to waterline breaks, so check current conditions before descending. No Excessive Heat Warning was active for the Grand Canyon area below 4000 feet as of the August 13, 2026 morning check. No Flash Flood Watch is active for Grand Canyon Country. Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park (key hiking messages, updated August 12, 2026); National Weather Service Flagstaff.

north-kaibab-coconino.note: North Kaibab Trail is open to foot traffic through Phantom Ranch, but the National Park Service advises increased caution near Supai Tunnel and the lower trail due to Dragon Bravo Fire burn-scar hazards, including debris flows, rockfalls, and flash flooding with little to no warning even when storms are not visible overhead; hikers should stay alert to posted forecasts and be prepared to move quickly to higher ground. Water is off at the North Kaibab Trailhead and Supai Tunnel, but on at Cottonwood Campground and Manzanita Day Use Area; single bottles and gallon jugs can be purchased at the North Rim General Store from 9am to 4pm daily. Grand Canyon National Park rates today's heat risk at Phantom Ranch as Major. No Excessive Heat Warning was active for the Grand Canyon area below 4000 feet as of the August 13, 2026 morning check. Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park (key hiking messages, updated August 12, 2026); National Weather Service Flagstaff.
